original.statement: Two new Prometheus metrics for certificate issuance and expiration times are now available: certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds.

decision.reason: [ev-e8facc7cba98] only says two new Prometheus metrics were added (certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds). It does not say a new endpoint was added, and it names neither a GET /metrics path nor the controller component. So 'api-endpoint GET /metrics added' misreads the change: new metric series were added, not the endpoint. No subject family covers a metric name, so the evidence does not support a corrected typed assertion either.
